title: Dazo - Musicyt
description: A lightweight, responsive web-based music platform for searching and playing YouTube music through a focused audio player.
overview: Dazo - Musicyt is a web-based music platform that brings search, playback, audio customization, lyrics, and personal music management into one responsive experience.
role: Personal project · Backend and application development
features: Go REST API endpoints for music search, audio stream extraction, and audio proxy handling
Customizable audio equalizer using the Web Audio API
Synchronized lyrics and dynamic album artwork
Playback queue, shuffle, repeat, and playlist management
Liked songs and playback history using LocalStorage
technicalWork: Implemented backend endpoints in Go to support music search and audio delivery workflows
Integrated yt-dlp to retrieve direct audio streams
Built interactive playback controls and music management with JavaScript
Connected the equalizer interface to the Web Audio API
Included Rust and WebAssembly in the audio-engine technology stack
engineeringNotes: Coordinating search, stream retrieval, and browser playback across separate application responsibilities
Keeping playback state, queue actions, and user-managed music data consistent
Providing responsive controls while supporting configurable audio processing

title: Jatinusa - Website
description: A full-stack furniture commerce platform designed for teak furniture businesses to showcase products, manage inventory, and provide product price estimates.
overview: Jatinusa is a furniture e-commerce website concept for teak furniture businesses. It combines a responsive product catalog with customer-facing shopping features and product management capabilities.
features: Responsive furniture catalog and product browsing
technicalWork: Developed responsive catalog and product interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Built backend functionality with Node.js and Express.js
Integrated MySQL for product data and database operations
Implemented authentication, product CRUD, cart, and price estimation features
engineeringNotes: Connecting product presentation with persistent relational product data
Supporting both customer shopping flows and product-management operations
Keeping catalog and estimation interactions understandable across screen sizes
